book.notes: Old Testament original is the Hebrew Masoretic text; New Testament original is the SBL Greek text. Transliteration is automatic and flagged. Hebrew verse numbering can differ from KJV numbering in a few psalms.

verses.original: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος ἐκλεκτῇ κυρίᾳ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτῆς, οὓς ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐγνωκότες τὴν ἀλήθειαν,
verses.translit: O presvyteros eklekte kyria kai tois teknois autes, ous ego agapo en alitheia, kai ouk ego monos alla kai pantes oi egnokotes ten alitheian,
verses.translation: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

verses.original: διὰ τὴν ἀλήθειαν τὴν μένουσαν ἐν ἡμῖν, καὶ μεθʼ ἡμῶν ἔσται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·
verses.translit: dia ten alitheian ten menoysan en emin, kai meth' emon estai eis ton aiona*
verses.translation: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

verses.original: ἔσται μεθʼ ἡμῶν χάρις ἔλεος εἰρήνη παρὰ θεοῦ πατρός, καὶ ⸀παρὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ πατρός, ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἀγάπῃ.
verses.translit: estai meth' emon haris eleos eirini para theou patros, kai para Iisou Hristou tou yiou tou patros, en alitheia kai agape.
verses.translation: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

verses.original: Ἐχάρην λίαν ὅτι εὕρηκα ἐκ τῶν τέκνων σου περιπατοῦντας ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καθὼς ἐντολὴν ἐλάβομεν παρὰ τοῦ πατρός.
verses.translit: Eharin lian oti eurika ek ton teknon soy peripatountas en alitheia, kathos entolen elavomen para tou patros.
verses.translation: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

verses.original: καὶ νῦν ἐρωτῶ σε, κυρία, οὐχ ὡς ἐντολὴν ⸂καινὴν γράφων σοι⸃ ἀλλὰ ἣν εἴχομεν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους.
verses.translit: kai nun eroto se, kyria, ouh os entolen kainen grafon soi alla en eihomen ap' arhes, ina agapomen alliloys.
verses.translation: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη, ἵνα περιπατῶμεν κατὰ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ· αὕτη ⸂ἡ ἐντολή ἐστιν⸃, καθὼς ἠκούσατε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῇ περιπατῆτε.
verses.translit: kai auti estin e agapi, ina peripatomen kata tas entolas autou* auti e entoli estin, kathos ekoysate ap' arhes, ina en aute peripatete.
verses.translation: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

verses.original: ὅτι πολλοὶ πλάνοι ⸀ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸν κόσμον, οἱ μὴ ὁμολογοῦντες Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐρχόμενον ἐν σαρκί· οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πλάνος καὶ ὁ ἀντίχριστος.
verses.translit: oti polloi planoi exelthon eis ton kosmon, oi me omologountes Iisoun Hriston erhomenon en sarki* outos estin o planos kai o antihristos.
verses.translation: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

verses.original: βλέπετε ἑαυτούς, ἵνα μὴ ⸀ἀπολέσητε ἃ ⸀εἰργασάμεθα, ἀλλὰ μισθὸν πλήρη ⸀ἀπολάβητε.
verses.translit: vlepete eaytoys, ina me apolesite a eirgasametha, alla misthon pliri apolavite.
verses.translation: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ ⸀προάγων καὶ μὴ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ θεὸν οὐκ ἔχει· ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ⸀διδαχῇ, οὗτος καὶ τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει.
verses.translit: pas o proagon kai me menon en te didahe tou Hristou theon ouk ehei* o menon en te didahe, outos kai ton patera kai ton yion ehei.
verses.translation: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

verses.original: εἴ τις ἔρχεται πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ταύτην τὴν διδαχὴν οὐ φέρει, μὴ λαμβάνετε αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν καὶ χαίρειν αὐτῷ μὴ λέγετε·
verses.translit: ei tis erhetai pros umas kai taytin ten didahen ou ferei, me lamvanete auton eis oikian kai hairein auto me legete*
verses.translation: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

verses.original: ὁ ⸂λέγων γὰρ⸃ αὐτῷ χαίρειν κοινωνεῖ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ τοῖς πονηροῖς.
verses.translit: o legon gar auto hairein koinonei tois ergois autou tois ponirois.
verses.translation: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

verses.original: Πολλὰ ἔχων ὑμῖν γράφειν οὐκ ἐβουλήθην διὰ χάρτου καὶ μέλανος, ἀλλὰ ἐλπίζω ⸀γενέσθαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ στόμα πρὸς στόμα λαλῆσαι, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ⸀ὑμῶν ⸂πεπληρωμένη ᾖ⸃.
verses.translit: Polla ehon umin grafein ouk evoylithin dia hartoy kai melanos, alla elpizo genesthai pros umas kai stoma pros stoma lalesai, ina e hara umon pepliromeni e.
verses.translation: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεταί σε τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἀδελφῆς σου τῆς ⸀ἐκλεκτῆς.
verses.translit: Aspazetai se ta tekna tes adelfes soy tes eklektes.
verses.translation: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

verses.original: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος Γαΐῳ τῷ ἀγαπητῷ, ὃν ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.translit: O presvyteros GaIo to agapito, on ego agapo en alitheia.
verses.translation: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητέ, περὶ πάντων εὔχομαί σε εὐοδοῦσθαι καὶ ὑγιαίνειν, καθὼς εὐοδοῦταί σου ἡ ψυχή.
verses.translit: Agapite, peri panton euhomai se euodousthai kai ugiainein, kathos euodoutai soy e psyhi.
verses.translation: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

verses.original: ἐχάρην γὰρ λίαν ἐρχομένων ἀδελφῶν καὶ μαρτυρούντων σου τῇ ἀληθείᾳ, καθὼς σὺ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ περιπατεῖς.
verses.translit: eharin gar lian erhomenon adelfon kai martyroynton soy te alitheia, kathos su en alitheia peripateis.
verses.translation: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

verses.original: μειζοτέραν τούτων οὐκ ἔχω ⸀χαράν, ἵνα ἀκούω τὰ ἐμὰ τέκνα ἐν ⸀τῇ ἀληθείᾳ περιπατοῦντα.
verses.translit: meizoteran toyton ouk eho haran, ina akoyo ta ema tekna en te alitheia peripatounta.
verses.translation: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητέ, πιστὸν ποιεῖς ὃ ἐὰν ἐργάσῃ εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ⸀τοῦτο ξένους,
verses.translit: Agapite, piston poieis o ean ergase eis tous adelfous kai touto xenoys,
verses.translation: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

verses.original: οἳ ἐμαρτύρησάν σου τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐνώπιον ἐκκλησίας, οὓς καλῶς ποιήσεις προπέμψας ἀξίως τοῦ θεοῦ·
verses.translit: oi emartyrisan soy te agape enopion ekklisias, ous kalos poiiseis propempsas axios tou theou*
verses.translation: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

verses.original: ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ ὀνόματος ἐξῆλθον μηδὲν λαμβάνοντες ἀπὸ τῶν ⸀ἐθνικῶν.
verses.translit: uper gar tou onomatos exelthon miden lamvanontes apo ton ethnikon.
verses.translation: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς οὖν ὀφείλομεν ⸀ὑπολαμβάνειν τοὺς τοιούτους, ἵνα συνεργοὶ γινώμεθα τῇ ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.translit: emeis oun ofeilomen upolamvanein tous toioytoys, ina synergoi ginometha te alitheia.
verses.translation: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

verses.original: Ἔγραψά ⸀τι τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ· ἀλλʼ ὁ φιλοπρωτεύων αὐτῶν Διοτρέφης οὐκ ἐπιδέχεται ἡμᾶς.
verses.translit: Egrapsa ti te ekklisia* all' o filoproteyon auton Diotrefis ouk epidehetai emas.
verses.translation: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο, ἐὰν ἔλθω, ὑπομνήσω αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιεῖ, λόγοις πονηροῖς φλυαρῶν ἡμᾶς, καὶ μὴ ἀρκούμενος ἐπὶ τούτοις οὔτε αὐτὸς ἐπιδέχεται τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τοὺς βουλομένους κωλύει καὶ ἐκ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐκβάλλει.
verses.translit: dia touto, ean eltho, upomniso autou ta erga a poiei, logois ponirois flyaron emas, kai me arkoymenos epi toytois oute autos epidehetai tous adelfous kai tous voylomenoys kolyei kai ek tes ekklisias ekvallei.
verses.translation: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητέ, μὴ μιμοῦ τὸ κακὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ ἀγαθόν. ὁ ἀγαθοποιῶν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν· ὁ κακοποιῶν οὐχ ἑώρακεν τὸν θεόν.
verses.translit: Agapite, me mimou to kakon alla to agathon. o agathopoion ek tou theou estin* o kakopoion ouh eoraken ton theon.
verses.translation: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

verses.original: Δημητρίῳ μεμαρτύρηται ὑπὸ πάντων καὶ ὑπὸ αὐτῆς τῆς ἀληθείας· καὶ ἡμεῖς δὲ μαρτυροῦμεν, καὶ ⸀οἶδας ὅτι ἡ μαρτυρία ἡμῶν ἀληθής ἐστιν.
verses.translit: Dimitrio memartyritai upo panton kai upo autes tes alitheias* kai emeis de martyroumen, kai oidas oti e martyria emon alithis estin.
verses.translation: Demetrius hath good report of all men , and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

verses.original: Πολλὰ εἶχον ⸂γράψαι σοι⸃, ἀλλʼ οὐ θέλω διὰ μέλανος καὶ καλάμου σοι ⸀γράφειν·
verses.translit: Polla eihon grapsai soi, all' ou thelo dia melanos kai kalamoy soi grafein*
verses.translation: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

verses.original: ἐλπίζω δὲ εὐθέως ⸂σε ἰδεῖν⸃, καὶ στόμα πρὸς στόμα λαλήσομεν.
verses.translit: elpizo de eutheos se idein, kai stoma pros stoma lalisomen.
verses.translation: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.

verses.original: Ἰούδας Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δοῦλος, ἀδελφὸς δὲ Ἰακώβου, τοῖς ἐν θεῷ πατρὶ ⸀ἠγαπημένοις καὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ τετηρημένοις κλητοῖς·
verses.translit: Ioydas Iisou Hristou doulos, adelfos de Iakovoy, tois en theo patri egapimenois kai Iisou Hristo tetirimenois klitois*
verses.translation: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

verses.original: ἔλεος ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ ἀγάπη πληθυνθείη.
verses.translit: eleos umin kai eirini kai agapi plithyntheii.
verses.translation: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί, πᾶσαν σπουδὴν ποιούμενος γράφειν ὑμῖν περὶ τῆς κοινῆς ⸀ἡμῶν σωτηρίας ἀνάγκην ἔσχον γράψαι ὑμῖν παρακαλῶν ἐπαγωνίζεσθαι τῇ ἅπαξ παραδοθείσῃ τοῖς ἁγίοις πίστει.
verses.translit: Agapitoi, pasan spoyden poioymenos grafein umin peri tes koines emon sotirias anagkin eshon grapsai umin parakalon epagonizesthai te apax paradotheise tois agiois pistei.
verses.translation: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

verses.original: παρεισέδυσαν γάρ τινες ἄνθρωποι, οἱ πάλαι προγεγραμμένοι εἰς τοῦτο τὸ κρίμα, ἀσεβεῖς, τὴν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν χάριτα μετατιθέντες εἰς ἀσέλγειαν καὶ τὸν μόνον ⸀δεσπότην καὶ κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἀρνούμενοι.
verses.translit: pareisedysan gar tines anthropoi, oi palai progegrammenoi eis touto to krima, aseveis, ten tou theou emon harita metatithentes eis aselgeian kai ton monon despotin kai kyrion emon Iisoun Hriston arnoymenoi.
verses.translation: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.original: Ὑπομνῆσαι δὲ ὑμᾶς βούλομαι, εἰδότας ⸂ὑμᾶς ἅπαξ⸃ ⸀πάντα, ὅτι ⸀Ἰησοῦς λαὸν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου σώσας τὸ δεύτερον τοὺς μὴ πιστεύσαντας ἀπώλεσεν,
verses.translit: Upomnesai de umas voylomai, eidotas umas apax panta, oti Iisous laon ek ges Aigyptoy sosas to deyteron tous me pisteysantas apolesen,
verses.translation: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

verses.original: ἀγγέλους τε τοὺς μὴ τηρήσαντας τὴν ἑαυτῶν ἀρχὴν ἀλλὰ ἀπολιπόντας τὸ ἴδιον οἰκητήριον εἰς κρίσιν μεγάλης ἡμέρας δεσμοῖς ἀϊδίοις ὑπὸ ζόφον τετήρηκεν·
verses.translit: aggeloys te tous me tirisantas ten eayton arhen alla apolipontas to idion oikitirion eis krisin megalis emeras desmois aidiois upo zofon tetiriken*
verses.translation: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

verses.original: ὡς Σόδομα καὶ Γόμορρα καὶ αἱ περὶ αὐτὰς πόλεις, τὸν ὅμοιον ⸂τρόπον τούτοις⸃ ἐκπορνεύσασαι καὶ ἀπελθοῦσαι ὀπίσω σαρκὸς ἑτέρας, πρόκεινται δεῖγμα πυρὸς αἰωνίου δίκην ὑπέχουσαι.
verses.translit: os Sodoma kai Gomorra kai ai peri autas poleis, ton omoion tropon toytois ekporneysasai kai apelthousai opiso sarkos eteras, prokeintai deigma pyros aionioy dikin upehoysai.
verses.translation: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

verses.original: Ὁμοίως μέντοι καὶ οὗτοι ἐνυπνιαζόμενοι σάρκα μὲν μιαίνουσιν, κυριότητα δὲ ἀθετοῦσιν, δόξας δὲ βλασφημοῦσιν.
verses.translit: Omoios mentoi kai outoi enypniazomenoi sarka men miainoysin, kyriotita de athetousin, doxas de vlasfimousin.
verses.translation: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Μιχαὴλ ὁ ἀρχάγγελος, ὅτε τῷ διαβόλῳ διακρινόμενος διελέγετο περὶ τοῦ Μωϋσέως σώματος, οὐκ ἐτόλμησεν κρίσιν ἐπενεγκεῖν βλασφημίας, ἀλλὰ εἶπεν· Ἐπιτιμήσαι σοι κύριος.
verses.translit: o de Mihael o arhaggelos, ote to diavolo diakrinomenos dielegeto peri tou Moyseos somatos, ouk etolmisen krisin epenegkein vlasfimias, alla eipen* Epitimisai soi kyrios.
verses.translation: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

verses.original: οὗτοι δὲ ὅσα μὲν οὐκ οἴδασιν βλασφημοῦσιν, ὅσα δὲ φυσικῶς ὡς τὰ ἄλογα ζῷα ἐπίστανται, ἐν τούτοις φθείρονται.
verses.translit: outoi de osa men ouk oidasin vlasfimousin, osa de fysikos os ta aloga zoa epistantai, en toytois ftheirontai.
verses.translation: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

verses.original: οὐαὶ αὐτοῖς, ὅτι τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Κάϊν ἐπορεύθησαν, καὶ τῇ πλάνῃ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ μισθοῦ ἐξεχύθησαν, καὶ τῇ ἀντιλογίᾳ τοῦ Κόρε ἀπώλοντο.
verses.translit: ouai autois, oti te odo tou Kain eporeythisan, kai te plane tou Valaam misthou exehythisan, kai te antilogia tou Kore apolonto.
verses.translation: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

verses.original: οὗτοί εἰσιν ⸀οἱ ἐν ταῖς ἀγάπαις ὑμῶν σπιλάδες συνευωχούμενοι, ἀφόβως ἑαυτοὺς ποιμαίνοντες, νεφέλαι ἄνυδροι ὑπὸ ἀνέμων παραφερόμεναι, δένδρα φθινοπωρινὰ ἄκαρπα δὶς ἀποθανόντα ἐκριζωθέντα,
verses.translit: outoi eisin oi en tais agapais umon spilades syneyohoymenoi, afovos eaytous poimainontes, nefelai anydroi upo anemon paraferomenai, dendra fthinoporina akarpa dis apothanonta ekrizothenta,
verses.translation: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

verses.original: κύματα ἄγρια θαλάσσης ἐπαφρίζοντα τὰς ἑαυτῶν αἰσχύνας, ἀστέρες πλανῆται οἷς ὁ ζόφος τοῦ σκότους εἰς αἰῶνα τετήρηται.
verses.translit: kymata agria thalassis epafrizonta tas eayton aishynas, asteres planetai ois o zofos tou skotoys eis aiona tetiritai.
verses.translation: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

verses.original: Προεφήτευσεν δὲ καὶ τούτοις ἕβδομος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ Ἑνὼχ λέγων· Ἰδοὺ ἦλθεν κύριος ἐν ἁγίαις μυριάσιν αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: Proefiteysen de kai toytois evdomos apo Adam Enoh legon* Idou elthen kyrios en agiais myriasin autou,
verses.translation: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

verses.original: ποιῆσαι κρίσιν κατὰ πάντων καὶ ἐλέγξαι ⸂πάντας τοὺς ἀσεβεῖς⸃ περὶ πάντων τῶν ἔργων ἀσεβείας αὐτῶν ὧν ἠσέβησαν καὶ περὶ πάντων τῶν σκληρῶν ὧν ἐλάλησαν κατʼ αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀσεβεῖς.
verses.translit: poiesai krisin kata panton kai elegxai pantas tous aseveis peri panton ton ergon aseveias auton on esevisan kai peri panton ton skliron on elalisan kat' autou amartoloi aseveis.
verses.translation: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

verses.original: οὗτοί εἰσιν γογγυσταί, μεμψίμοιροι, κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας ⸀αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι, καὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν λαλεῖ ὑπέρογκα, θαυμάζοντες πρόσωπα ὠφελείας χάριν.
verses.translit: outoi eisin goggystai, mempsimoiroi, kata tas epithymias auton poreyomenoi, kai to stoma auton lalei uperogka, thaymazontes prosopa ofeleias harin.
verses.translation: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀγαπητοί, μνήσθητε τῶν ῥημάτων τῶν προειρημένων ὑπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
verses.translit: Umeis de, agapitoi, mnisthite ton Rimaton ton proeirimenon upo ton apostolon tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou*
verses.translation: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.original: ὅτι ἔλεγον ⸀ὑμῖν· ⸂Ἐπʼ ἐσχάτου χρόνου⸃ ἔσονται ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἑαυτῶν ἐπιθυμίας πορευόμενοι τῶν ἀσεβειῶν.
verses.translit: oti elegon umin* Ep' eshatoy hronoy esontai empaiktai kata tas eayton epithymias poreyomenoi ton aseveion.
verses.translation: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

verses.original: οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἀποδιορίζοντες, ψυχικοί, πνεῦμα μὴ ἔχοντες.
verses.translit: outoi eisin oi apodiorizontes, psyhikoi, pneuma me ehontes.
verses.translation: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀγαπητοί, ⸂ἐποικοδομοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς τῇ ἁγιωτάτῃ ὑμῶν πίστει⸃, ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ προσευχόμενοι,
verses.translit: umeis de, agapitoi, epoikodomountes eaytous te agiotate umon pistei, en pneymati agio proseyhomenoi,
verses.translation: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

verses.original: ἑαυτοὺς ἐν ἀγάπῃ θεοῦ τηρήσατε προσδεχόμενοι τὸ ἔλεος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: eaytous en agape theou tirisate prosdehomenoi to eleos tou kyrioy emon Iisou Hristou eis zoen aionion.
verses.translation: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

verses.original: καὶ οὓς μὲν ⸀ἐλεᾶτε ⸂διακρινομένους,
verses.translit: kai ous men eleate diakrinomenoys,
verses.translation: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

verses.original: οὓς δὲ σῴζετε ἐκ πυρὸς ἁρπάζοντες, οὓς δὲ ἐλεᾶτε ἐν φόβῳ⸃, μισοῦντες καὶ τὸν ἀπὸ τῆς σαρκὸς ἐσπιλωμένον χιτῶνα.
verses.translit: ous de sozete ek pyros arpazontes, ous de eleate en fovo, misountes kai ton apo tes sarkos espilomenon hitona.
verses.translation: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

verses.original: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ φυλάξαι ⸀ὑμᾶς ἀπταίστους καὶ στῆσαι κατενώπιον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ ἀμώμους ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει
verses.translit: To de dynameno fylaxai umas aptaistoys kai stesai katenopion tes doxis autou amomoys en agalliasei
verses.translation: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

verses.original: ⸀μόνῳ θεῷ σωτῆρι ἡμῶν ⸂διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν⸃ ⸀δόξα μεγαλωσύνη κράτος καὶ ἐξουσία ⸂πρὸ παντὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος⸃ καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: mono theo soteri emon dia Iisou Hristou tou kyrioy emon doxa megalosyni kratos kai exoysia pro pantos tou aionos kai nun kai eis pantas tous aionas* amin.
verses.translation: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

verses.original: Ἀποκάλυψις Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ, ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει, καὶ ἐσήμανεν ἀποστείλας διὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου αὐτοῦ τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννῃ,
verses.translit: Apokalypsis Iisou Hristou, en edoken auto o theos deixai tois doylois autou, a dei genesthai en tahei, kai esimanen aposteilas dia tou aggeloy autou to doylo autou Ioanne,
verses.translation: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

verses.original: ὃς ἐμαρτύρησεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅσα εἶδεν.
verses.translit: os emartyrisen ton logon tou theou kai ten martyrian Iisou Hristou, osa eiden.
verses.translation: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

verses.original: μακάριος ὁ ἀναγινώσκων καὶ οἱ ἀκούοντες τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας καὶ τηροῦντες τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ γεγραμμένα, ὁ γὰρ καιρὸς ἐγγύς.
verses.translit: makarios o anaginoskon kai oi akoyontes tous logoys tes profiteias kai tirountes ta en aute gegrammena, o gar kairos eggys.
verses.translation: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

verses.original: Ἰωάννης ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις ταῖς ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ⸀ἀπὸ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἑπτὰ πνευμάτων ἃ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: Ioannis tais epta ekklisiais tais en te Asia* haris umin kai eirini apo o on kai o en kai o erhomenos, kai apo ton epta pneymaton a enopion tou thronoy autou,
verses.translation: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

verses.original: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστός, ὁ πρωτότοκος τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς. Τῷ ἀγαπῶντι ἡμᾶς καὶ ⸀λύσαντι ἡμᾶς ⸀ἐκ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ—
verses.translit: kai apo Iisou Hristou, o martys o pistos, o prototokos ton nekron kai o arhon ton vasileon tes ges. To agaponti emas kai lysanti emas ek ton amartion emon en to aimati autou--
verses.translation: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

verses.original: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς βασιλείαν, ἱερεῖς τῷ θεῷ καὶ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ— αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ⸂τῶν αἰώνων⸃· ἀμήν.
verses.translit: kai epoiisen emas vasileian, iereis to theo kai patri autou-- auto e doxa kai to kratos eis tous aionas ton aionon* amin.
verses.translation: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν, καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν πᾶς ὀφθαλμὸς καὶ οἵτινες αὐτὸν ἐξεκέντησαν, καὶ κόψονται ἐπʼ αὐτὸν πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς. ναί, ἀμήν.
verses.translit: Idou erhetai meta ton nefelon, kai opsetai auton pas ofthalmos kai oitines auton exekentisan, kai kopsontai ep' auton pasai ai fylai tes ges. nai, amin.
verses.translation: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, λέγει κύριος, ὁ θεός, ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, ὁ παντοκράτωρ.
verses.translit: Ego eimi to Alfa kai to O, legei kyrios, o theos, o on kai o en kai o erhomenos, o pantokrator.
verses.translation: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

verses.original: Ἐγὼ Ἰωάννης, ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ⸀συγκοινωνὸς ἐν τῇ θλίψει καὶ βασιλείᾳ καὶ ὑπομονῇ ⸀ἐν Ἰησοῦ, ἐγενόμην ἐν τῇ νήσῳ τῇ καλουμένῃ Πάτμῳ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ⸀καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ⸀Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: Ego Ioannis, o adelfos umon kai sygkoinonos en te thlipsei kai vasileia kai upomone en Iisou, egenomin en te niso te kaloymene Patmo dia ton logon tou theou kai ten martyrian Iisou.
verses.translation: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

verses.original: ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι ἐν τῇ κυριακῇ ἡμέρᾳ, καὶ ἤκουσα ⸂ὀπίσω μου φωνὴν⸃ μεγάλην ὡς σάλπιγγος
verses.translit: egenomin en pneymati en te kyriake emera, kai ekoysa opiso moy fonen megalin os salpiggos
verses.translation: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

verses.original: λεγούσης· Ὃ βλέπεις γράψον εἰς βιβλίον καὶ πέμψον ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις, εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εἰς Σμύρναν καὶ εἰς Πέργαμον καὶ εἰς Θυάτειρα καὶ εἰς Σάρδεις καὶ εἰς Φιλαδέλφειαν καὶ εἰς Λαοδίκειαν.
verses.translit: legoysis* O vlepeis grapson eis vivlion kai pempson tais epta ekklisiais, eis Efeson kai eis Smyrnan kai eis Pergamon kai eis Thyateira kai eis Sardeis kai eis Filadelfeian kai eis Laodikeian.
verses.translation: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

verses.original: ⸀Καὶ ἐπέστρεψα βλέπειν τὴν φωνὴν ἥτις ἐλάλει μετʼ ἐμοῦ· καὶ ἐπιστρέψας εἶδον ἑπτὰ λυχνίας χρυσᾶς,
verses.translit: Kai epestrepsa vlepein ten fonen etis elalei met' emou* kai epistrepsas eidon epta lyhnias hrysas,
verses.translation: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;

verses.original: καὶ ἐν μέσῳ ⸀τῶν λυχνιῶν ὅμοιον ⸀υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου, ἐνδεδυμένον ποδήρη καὶ περιεζωσμένον πρὸς τοῖς μαστοῖς ζώνην χρυσᾶν·
verses.translit: kai en meso ton lyhnion omoion yion anthropoy, endedymenon podiri kai periezosmenon pros tois mastois zonin hrysan*
verses.translation: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ τρίχες λευκαὶ ὡς ἔριον λευκόν, ὡς χιών, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς φλὸξ πυρός,
verses.translit: e de kefale autou kai ai trihes leykai os erion leykon, os hion, kai oi ofthalmoi autou os flox pyros,
verses.translation: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

verses.original: καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ, ὡς ἐν καμίνῳ ⸀πεπυρωμένης, καὶ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ὡς φωνὴ ὑδάτων πολλῶν,
verses.translit: kai oi podes autou omoioi halkolivano, os en kamino pepyromenis, kai e fone autou os fone udaton pollon,
verses.translation: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.

verses.original: καὶ ἔχων ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ ⸂χειρὶ αὐτοῦ⸃ ἀστέρας ἑπτά, καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ῥομφαία δίστομος ὀξεῖα ἐκπορευομένη, καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος φαίνει ἐν τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai ehon en te dexia heiri autou asteras epta, kai ek tou stomatos autou Romfaia distomos oxeia ekporeyomeni, kai e opsis autou os o elios fainei en te dynamei autou.
verses.translation: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε εἶδον αὐτόν, ἔπεσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὡς νεκρός· καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ ἐμὲ λέγων· Μὴ φοβοῦ· ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος,
verses.translit: Kai ote eidon auton, epesa pros tous podas autou os nekros* kai ethiken ten dexian autou ep' eme legon* Me fovou* ego eimi o protos kai o eshatos,
verses.translation: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

verses.original: καὶ ὁ ζῶν— καὶ ἐγενόμην νεκρὸς καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν ⸀αἰώνων— καὶ ἔχω τὰς κλεῖς τοῦ θανάτου καὶ τοῦ ᾅδου.
verses.translit: kai o zon-- kai egenomin nekros kai idou zon eimi eis tous aionas ton aionon-- kai eho tas kleis tou thanatoy kai tou adoy.
verses.translation: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

verses.original: γράψον οὖν ἃ εἶδες καὶ ἃ εἰσὶν καὶ ἃ μέλλει ⸀γίνεσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα.
verses.translit: grapson oun a eides kai a eisin kai a mellei ginesthai meta tauta.
verses.translation: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;

verses.original: τὸ μυστήριον τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀστέρων ⸀οὓς εἶδες ἐπὶ τῆς δεξιᾶς μου, καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ λυχνίας τὰς χρυσᾶς· οἱ ἑπτὰ ἀστέρες ἄγγελοι τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησιῶν εἰσίν, καὶ αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαι εἰσίν.
verses.translit: to mystirion ton epta asteron ous eides epi tes dexias moy, kai tas epta lyhnias tas hrysas* oi epta asteres aggeloi ton epta ekklision eisin, kai ai lyhniai ai epta epta ekklisiai eisin.
verses.translation: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.

verses.original: Τῷ ἀγγέλῳ ⸀τῆς ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ κρατῶν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ, ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἑπτὰ λυχνιῶν τῶν χρυσῶν·
verses.translit: To aggelo tes en Efeso ekklisias grapson* Tade legei o kraton tous epta asteras en te dexia autou, o peripaton en meso ton epta lyhnion ton hryson*
verses.translation: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;

verses.original: Οἶδα τὰ ἔργα σου, καὶ τὸν ⸀κόπον καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου, καὶ ὅτι οὐ δύνῃ βαστάσαι κακούς, καὶ ἐπείρασας τοὺς λέγοντας ἑαυτοὺς ⸀ἀποστόλους, καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν, καὶ εὗρες αὐτοὺς ψευδεῖς·
verses.translit: Oida ta erga soy, kai ton kopon kai ten upomonin soy, kai oti ou dyne vastasai kakoys, kai epeirasas tous legontas eaytous apostoloys, kai ouk eisin, kai eures autous pseydeis*
verses.translation: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:

verses.original: καὶ ὑπομονὴν ἔχεις, καὶ ἐβάστασας διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ ⸂οὐ κεκοπίακες⸃.
verses.translit: kai upomonen eheis, kai evastasas dia to onoma moy, kai ou kekopiakes.
verses.translation: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name’s sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην σου τὴν πρώτην ἀφῆκες.
verses.translit: alla eho kata sou oti ten agapin soy ten protin afekes.
verses.translation: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

verses.original: μνημόνευε οὖν πόθεν ⸀πέπτωκας, καὶ μετανόησον καὶ τὰ πρῶτα ἔργα ποίησον· εἰ δὲ μή, ἔρχομαί ⸀σοι, καὶ κινήσω τὴν λυχνίαν σου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῆς, ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσῃς.
verses.translit: mnimoneye oun pothen peptokas, kai metanoison kai ta prota erga poiison* ei de mi, erhomai soi, kai kiniso ten lyhnian soy ek tou topoy autes, ean me metanoises.
verses.translation: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τοῦτο ἔχεις ὅτι μισεῖς τὰ ἔργα τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν, ἃ κἀγὼ μισῶ.
verses.translit: alla touto eheis oti miseis ta erga ton Nikolaiton, a kago miso.
verses.translation: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ φαγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ.
verses.translit: o ehon ous akoysato ti to pneuma legei tais ekklisiais. to nikonti doso auto fagein ek tou xyloy tes zoes, o estin en to paradeiso tou theou.
verses.translation: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ ⸀τῆς ἐν Σμύρνῃ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, ὃς ἐγένετο νεκρὸς καὶ ἔζησεν·
verses.translit: Kai to aggelo tes en Smyrne ekklisias grapson* Tade legei o protos kai o eshatos, os egeneto nekros kai ezisen*
verses.translation: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;

verses.original: Οἶδά ⸀σου τὴν θλῖψιν καὶ τὴν πτωχείαν, ἀλλὰ πλούσιος εἶ, καὶ τὴν βλασφημίαν ἐκ τῶν λεγόντων Ἰουδαίους εἶναι ἑαυτούς, καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν, ἀλλὰ συναγωγὴ τοῦ Σατανᾶ.
verses.translit: Oida soy ten thlipsin kai ten ptoheian, alla ploysios ei, kai ten vlasfimian ek ton legonton Ioydaioys einai eaytoys, kai ouk eisin, alla synagoge tou Satana.
verses.translation: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.

verses.original: ⸀μηδὲν φοβοῦ ἃ μέλλεις ⸀πάσχειν. ⸀ἰδοὺ μέλλει ⸀βάλλειν ὁ διάβολος ἐξ ὑμῶν εἰς φυλακὴν ἵνα πειρασθῆτε, καὶ ⸀ἕξετε θλῖψιν ἡμερῶν δέκα. γίνου πιστὸς ἄχρι θανάτου, καὶ δώσω σοι τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς.
verses.translit: miden fovou a melleis pashein. idou mellei vallein o diavolos ex umon eis fylaken ina peirasthete, kai exete thlipsin emeron deka. ginoy pistos ahri thanatoy, kai doso soi ton stefanon tes zoes.
verses.translation: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. ὁ νικῶν οὐ μὴ ἀδικηθῇ ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ δευτέρου.
verses.translit: o ehon ous akoysato ti to pneuma legei tais ekklisiais. o nikon ou me adikithe ek tou thanatoy tou deyteroy.
verses.translation: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Περγάμῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὴν ῥομφαίαν τὴν δίστομον τὴν ὀξεῖαν·
verses.translit: Kai to aggelo tes en Pergamo ekklisias grapson* Tade legei o ehon ten Romfaian ten distomon ten oxeian*
verses.translation: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;

verses.original: ⸀Οἶδα ποῦ κατοικεῖς, ὅπου ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Σατανᾶ, καὶ κρατεῖς τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὴν πίστιν μου ⸀καὶ ἐν ταῖς ⸀ἡμέραις Ἀντιπᾶς, ὁ μάρτυς μου, ὁ πιστός ⸀μου, ὃς ἀπεκτάνθη παρʼ ὑμῖν, ὅπου ὁ Σατανᾶς κατοικεῖ.
verses.translit: Oida pou katoikeis, opoy o thronos tou Satana, kai krateis to onoma moy, kai ouk erniso ten pistin moy kai en tais emerais Antipas, o martys moy, o pistos moy, os apektanthi par' umin, opoy o Satanas katoikei.
verses.translation: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s seat is : and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὀλίγα, ὅτι ἔχεις ἐκεῖ κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν Βαλαάμ, ὃς ⸂ἐδίδασκεν τῷ⸃ Βαλὰκ βαλεῖν σκάνδαλον ἐνώπιον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ, ⸀φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα καὶ πορνεῦσαι·
verses.translit: alla eho kata sou oliga, oti eheis ekei kratountas ten didahen Valaam, os edidasken to Valak valein skandalon enopion ton yion Israil, fagein eidolothyta kai porneusai*
verses.translation: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

verses.original: οὕτως ἔχεις καὶ σὺ κρατοῦντας τὴν ⸀διδαχὴν Νικολαϊτῶν ὁμοίως.
verses.translit: outos eheis kai su kratountas ten didahen Nikolaiton omoios.
verses.translation: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

verses.original: μετανόησον οὖν· εἰ δὲ μή, ἔρχομαί σοι ταχύ, καὶ πολεμήσω μετʼ αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ τοῦ στόματός μου.
verses.translit: metanoison oun* ei de mi, erhomai soi tahy, kai polemiso met' auton en te Romfaia tou stomatos moy.
verses.translation: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. τῷ νικῶντι δώσω ⸀αὐτῷ τοῦ μάννα τοῦ κεκρυμμένου, καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ ψῆφον λευκήν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ψῆφον ὄνομα καινὸν γεγραμμένον ὃ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν εἰ μὴ ὁ λαμβάνων.
verses.translit: o ehon ous akoysato ti to pneuma legei tais ekklisiais. to nikonti doso auto tou manna tou kekrymmenoy, kai doso auto psefon leykin, kai epi ten psefon onoma kainon gegrammenon o oudeis oiden ei me o lamvanon.
verses.translation: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ ⸀τῆς ἐν Θυατείροις ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ ἔχων τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ ὡς φλόγα πυρός, καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ·
verses.translit: Kai to aggelo tes en Thyateirois ekklisias grapson* Tade legei o yios tou theou, o ehon tous ofthalmous autou os floga pyros, kai oi podes autou omoioi halkolivano*
verses.translation: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;

verses.original: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, καὶ τὴν ⸂ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν⸃ καὶ τὴν διακονίαν καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου, καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου τὰ ἔσχατα πλείονα τῶν πρώτων.
verses.translit: Oida soy ta erga, kai ten agapin kai ten pistin kai ten diakonian kai ten upomonin soy, kai ta erga soy ta eshata pleiona ton proton.
verses.translation: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι ἀφεῖς τὴν ⸀γυναῖκα Ἰεζάβελ, ἡ ⸀λέγουσα ἑαυτὴν προφῆτιν, καὶ διδάσκει καὶ πλανᾷ τοὺς ἐμοὺς δούλους πορνεῦσαι καὶ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα.
verses.translit: alla eho kata sou oti afeis ten gynaika Iezavel, e legoysa eayten profetin, kai didaskei kai plana tous emous doyloys porneusai kai fagein eidolothyta.
verses.translation: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῇ χρόνον ἵνα μετανοήσῃ, καὶ οὐ θέλει μετανοῆσαι ἐκ τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: kai edoka aute hronon ina metanoise, kai ou thelei metanoesai ek tes porneias autes.
verses.translation: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

verses.original: ἰδοὺ βάλλω αὐτὴν εἰς κλίνην, καὶ τοὺς μοιχεύοντας μετʼ αὐτῆς εἰς θλῖψιν μεγάλην, ἐὰν μὴ ⸀μετανοήσωσιν ἐκ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς·
verses.translit: idou vallo auten eis klinin, kai tous moiheyontas met' autes eis thlipsin megalin, ean me metanoisosin ek ton ergon autes*
verses.translation: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς ἀποκτενῶ ἐν θανάτῳ· καὶ γνώσονται πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἐραυνῶν νεφροὺς καὶ καρδίας, καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: kai ta tekna autes apokteno en thanato* kai gnosontai pasai ai ekklisiai oti ego eimi o eraynon nefrous kai kardias, kai doso umin ekasto kata ta erga umon.
verses.translation: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

verses.original: ὑμῖν δὲ λέγω τοῖς λοιποῖς τοῖς ἐν Θυατείροις, ὅσοι οὐκ ἔχουσιν τὴν διδαχὴν ταύτην, οἵτινες οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰ βαθέα τοῦ Σατανᾶ, ὡς λέγουσιν, οὐ βάλλω ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς ἄλλο βάρος·
verses.translit: umin de lego tois loipois tois en Thyateirois, osoi ouk ehoysin ten didahen taytin, oitines ouk egnosan ta vathea tou Satana, os legoysin, ou vallo ef' umas allo varos*
verses.translation: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

verses.original: πλὴν ὃ ἔχετε κρατήσατε ἄχρι οὗ ἂν ἥξω.
verses.translit: plen o ehete kratisate ahri ou an exo.
verses.translation: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ νικῶν καὶ ὁ τηρῶν ἄχρι τέλους τὰ ἔργα μου, δώσω αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν,
verses.translit: kai o nikon kai o tiron ahri teloys ta erga moy, doso auto exoysian epi ton ethnon,
verses.translation: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

verses.original: καὶ ποιμανεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ ὡς τὰ σκεύη τὰ κεραμικὰ ⸀συντρίβεται,
verses.translit: kai poimanei autous en Ravdo sidira os ta skeyi ta keramika syntrivetai,
verses.translation: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

verses.original: ὡς κἀγὼ εἴληφα παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ τὸν ἀστέρα τὸν πρωϊνόν.
verses.translit: os kago eilifa para tou patros moy, kai doso auto ton astera ton proinon.
verses.translation: And I will give him the morning star.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.
verses.translit: o ehon ous akoysato ti to pneuma legei tais ekklisiais.
verses.translation: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Σάρδεσιν ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὰ ἑπτὰ πνεύματα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας· Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, ὅτι ὄνομα ἔχεις ὅτι ζῇς, καὶ νεκρὸς εἶ.
verses.translit: Kai to aggelo tes en Sardesin ekklisias grapson* Tade legei o ehon ta epta pneymata tou theou kai tous epta asteras* Oida soy ta erga, oti onoma eheis oti zes, kai nekros ei.
verses.translation: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

verses.original: γίνου γρηγορῶν, καὶ στήρισον τὰ λοιπὰ ἃ ⸂ἔμελλον ἀποθανεῖν⸃, οὐ γὰρ εὕρηκά σου ⸀τὰ ἔργα πεπληρωμένα ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ μου·
verses.translit: ginoy grigoron, kai stirison ta loipa a emellon apothanein, ou gar eurika soy ta erga pepliromena enopion tou theou moy*
verses.translation: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

verses.original: μνημόνευε οὖν πῶς εἴληφας καὶ ἤκουσας καὶ τήρει, καὶ μετανόησον· ἐὰν οὖν μὴ γρηγορήσῃς, ⸀ἥξω ὡς κλέπτης, καὶ οὐ μὴ ⸀γνῷς ποίαν ὥραν ἥξω ἐπὶ σέ·
verses.translit: mnimoneye oun pos eilifas kai ekoysas kai tirei, kai metanoison* ean oun me grigorises, exo os kleptis, kai ou me gnos poian oran exo epi se*
verses.translation: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ⸂ἔχεις ὀλίγα⸃ ὀνόματα ἐν Σάρδεσιν ἃ οὐκ ἐμόλυναν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν, καὶ περιπατήσουσιν μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐν λευκοῖς, ὅτι ἄξιοί εἰσιν.
verses.translit: alla eheis oliga onomata en Sardesin a ouk emolynan ta imatia auton, kai peripatisoysin met' emou en leykois, oti axioi eisin.
verses.translation: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

verses.original: ὁ νικῶν ⸀οὕτως περιβαλεῖται ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξαλείψω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς βίβλου τῆς ζωῆς, καὶ ὁμολογήσω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: o nikon outos perivaleitai en imatiois leykois, kai ou me exaleipso to onoma autou ek tes vivloy tes zoes, kai omologiso to onoma autou enopion tou patros moy kai enopion ton aggelon autou.
verses.translation: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.
verses.translit: o ehon ous akoysato ti to pneuma legei tais ekklisiais.
verses.translation: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Φιλαδελφείᾳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἅγιος, ὁ ἀληθινός, ὁ ἔχων τὴν κλεῖν ⸀Δαυίδ, ὁ ἀνοίγων καὶ οὐδεὶς κλείσει, ⸂καὶ κλείων⸃ καὶ οὐδεὶς ⸀ἀνοίγει·
verses.translit: Kai to aggelo tes en Filadelfeia ekklisias grapson* Tade legei o agios, o alithinos, o ehon ten klein Dayid, o anoigon kai oudeis kleisei, kai kleion kai oudeis anoigei*
verses.translation: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

verses.original: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα— ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἠνεῳγμένην, ἣν οὐδεὶς δύναται κλεῖσαι αὐτήν— ὅτι μικρὰν ἔχεις δύναμιν, καὶ ἐτήρησάς μου τὸν λόγον, καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὸ ὄνομά μου.
verses.translit: Oida soy ta erga-- idou dedoka enopion soy thyran eneogmenin, en oudeis dynatai kleisai autin-- oti mikran eheis dynamin, kai etirisas moy ton logon, kai ouk erniso to onoma moy.
verses.translation: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ⸀διδῶ ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς τοῦ Σατανᾶ, τῶν λεγόντων ἑαυτοὺς Ἰουδαίους εἶναι, καὶ οὐκ εἰσὶν ἀλλὰ ψεύδονται— ἰδοὺ ποιήσω αὐτοὺς ἵνα ⸂ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν⸃ ἐνώπιον τῶν ποδῶν σου, καὶ γνῶσιν ὅτι ⸀ἐγὼ ἠγάπησά σε.
verses.translit: idou dido ek tes synagoges tou Satana, ton legonton eaytous Ioydaioys einai, kai ouk eisin alla pseydontai-- idou poiiso autous ina exoysin kai proskynisoysin enopion ton podon soy, kai gnosin oti ego egapisa se.
verses.translation: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐτήρησας τὸν λόγον τῆς ὑπομονῆς μου, κἀγώ σε τηρήσω ἐκ τῆς ὥρας τοῦ πειρασμοῦ τῆς μελλούσης ἔρχεσθαι ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκουμένης ὅλης, πειράσαι τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
verses.translit: oti etirisas ton logon tes upomones moy, kago se tiriso ek tes oras tou peirasmou tes melloysis erhesthai epi tes oikoymenis olis, peirasai tous katoikountas epi tes ges.
verses.translation: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

verses.original: ἔρχομαι ταχύ· κράτει ὃ ἔχεις, ἵνα μηδεὶς λάβῃ τὸν στέφανόν σου.
verses.translit: erhomai tahy* kratei o eheis, ina mideis lave ton stefanon soy.
verses.translation: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

verses.original: ὁ νικῶν ποιήσω αὐτὸν στῦλον ἐν τῷ ναῷ τοῦ θεοῦ μου, καὶ ἔξω οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃ ἔτι, καὶ γράψω ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ μου καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως τοῦ θεοῦ μου, τῆς καινῆς Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἡ ⸀καταβαίνουσα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ μου, καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ καινόν.
verses.translit: o nikon poiiso auton stulon en to nao tou theou moy, kai exo ou me exelthe eti, kai grapso ep' auton to onoma tou theou moy kai to onoma tes poleos tou theou moy, tes kaines Ieroysalim, e katavainoysa ek tou ouranou apo tou theou moy, kai to onoma moy to kainon.
verses.translation: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.
verses.translit: o ehon ous akoysato ti to pneuma legei tais ekklisiais.
verses.translation: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ Ἀμήν, ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστὸς ⸀καὶ ἀληθινός, ἡ ἀρχὴ τῆς κτίσεως τοῦ θεοῦ·
verses.translit: Kai to aggelo tes en Laodikeia ekklisias grapson* Tade legei o Amin, o martys o pistos kai alithinos, e arhe tes ktiseos tou theou*
verses.translation: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

verses.original: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, ὅτι οὔτε ψυχρὸς εἶ οὔτε ζεστός. ὄφελον ψυχρὸς ἦς ἢ ζεστός.
verses.translit: Oida soy ta erga, oti oute psyhros ei oute zestos. ofelon psyhros es e zestos.
verses.translation: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

verses.original: οὕτως, ὅτι χλιαρὸς εἶ καὶ ⸀οὔτε ζεστὸς οὔτε ψυχρός, μέλλω σε ἐμέσαι ἐκ τοῦ στόματός μου.
verses.translit: outos, oti hliaros ei kai oute zestos oute psyhros, mello se emesai ek tou stomatos moy.
verses.translation: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

verses.original: ὅτι λέγεις ⸀ὅτι Πλούσιός εἰμι καὶ πεπλούτηκα καὶ ⸀οὐδὲν χρείαν ἔχω, καὶ οὐκ οἶδας ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ταλαίπωρος ⸀καὶ ἐλεεινὸς καὶ πτωχὸς καὶ τυφλὸς καὶ γυμνός,
verses.translit: oti legeis oti Ploysios eimi kai peploytika kai ouden hreian eho, kai ouk oidas oti su ei o talaiporos kai eleeinos kai ptohos kai tyflos kai gymnos,
verses.translation: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

verses.original: συμβουλεύω σοι ἀγοράσαι ⸂παρʼ ἐμοῦ χρυσίον⸃ πεπυρωμένον ἐκ πυρὸς ἵνα πλουτήσῃς, καὶ ἱμάτια λευκὰ ἵνα περιβάλῃ καὶ μὴ φανερωθῇ ἡ αἰσχύνη τῆς γυμνότητός σου, καὶ κολλούριον ⸀ἐγχρῖσαι τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου ἵνα βλέπῃς.
verses.translit: symvoyleyo soi agorasai par' emou hrysion pepyromenon ek pyros ina ploytises, kai imatia leyka ina perivale kai me fanerothe e aishyni tes gymnotitos soy, kai kolloyrion eghrisai tous ofthalmoys soy ina vlepes.
verses.translation: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

verses.original: ἐγὼ ὅσους ἐὰν φιλῶ ἐλέγχω καὶ παιδεύω· ⸀ζήλευε οὖν καὶ μετανόησον.
verses.translit: ego osoys ean filo elegho kai paideyo* zileye oun kai metanoison.
verses.translation: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ἕστηκα ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν καὶ κρούω· ἐάν τις ἀκούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ ἀνοίξῃ τὴν θύραν, ⸀καὶ εἰσελεύσομαι πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ δειπνήσω μετʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς μετʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.translit: idou estika epi ten thyran kai kroyo* ean tis akoyse tes fones moy kai anoixe ten thyran, kai eiseleysomai pros auton kai deipniso met' autou kai autos met' emou.
verses.translation: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

verses.original: ὁ νικῶν δώσω αὐτῷ καθίσαι μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ μου, ὡς κἀγὼ ἐνίκησα καὶ ἐκάθισα μετὰ τοῦ πατρός μου ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: o nikon doso auto kathisai met' emou en to throno moy, os kago enikisa kai ekathisa meta tou patros moy en to throno autou.
verses.translation: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.
verses.translit: o ehon ous akoysato ti to pneuma legei tais ekklisiais.
verses.translation: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ θύρα ἠνεῳγμένη ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἡ πρώτη ἣν ἤκουσα ὡς σάλπιγγος λαλούσης μετʼ ἐμοῦ, λέγων· Ἀνάβα ὧδε, καὶ δείξω σοι ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι. μετὰ ταῦτα
verses.translit: Meta tauta eidon, kai idou thyra eneogmeni en to ourano, kai e fone e proti en ekoysa os salpiggos laloysis met' emou, legon* Anava ode, kai deixo soi a dei genesthai. meta tauta
verses.translation: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

verses.original: ⸀εὐθέως ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι· καὶ ἰδοὺ θρόνος ἔκειτο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον καθήμενος,
verses.translit: eutheos egenomin en pneymati* kai idou thronos ekeito en to ourano, kai epi ton thronon kathimenos,
verses.translation: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.

verses.original: ⸂καὶ ὁ καθήμενος⸃ ὅμοιος ὁράσει λίθῳ ἰάσπιδι καὶ σαρδίῳ, καὶ ἶρις κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου ⸂ὅμοιος ὁράσει σμαραγδίνῳ⸃.
verses.translit: kai o kathimenos omoios orasei litho iaspidi kai sardio, kai iris kyklothen tou thronoy omoios orasei smaragdino.
verses.translation: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

verses.original: καὶ κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου ⸀θρόνοι εἴκοσι τέσσαρες, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ⸀θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρας πρεσβυτέρους καθημένους περιβεβλημένους ⸀ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν στεφάνους χρυσοῦς.
verses.translit: kai kyklothen tou thronoy thronoi eikosi tessares, kai epi tous thronoys eikosi tessaras presvyteroys kathimenoys perivevlimenoys en imatiois leykois, kai epi tas kefalas auton stefanoys hrysous.
verses.translation: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

verses.original: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου ἐκπορεύονται ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί· καὶ ἑπτὰ λαμπάδες πυρὸς καιόμεναι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, ⸀ἅ εἰσιν ⸀τὰ ἑπτὰ πνεύματα τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.translit: kai ek tou thronoy ekporeyontai astrapai kai fonai kai vrontai* kai epta lampades pyros kaiomenai enopion tou thronoy, a eisin ta epta pneymata tou theou,
verses.translation: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

verses.original: καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ὡς θάλασσα ὑαλίνη ὁμοία κρυστάλλῳ. Καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου τέσσαρα ζῷα γέμοντα ὀφθαλμῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν·
verses.translit: kai enopion tou thronoy os thalassa ualini omoia krystallo. Kai en meso tou thronoy kai kyklo tou thronoy tessara zoa gemonta ofthalmon emprosthen kai opisthen*
verses.translation: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

verses.original: καὶ τὸ ζῷον τὸ πρῶτον ὅμοιον λέοντι, καὶ τὸ δεύτερον ζῷον ὅμοιον μόσχῳ, καὶ τὸ τρίτον ζῷον ⸀ἔχων ⸂τὸ πρόσωπον ὡς⸃ ἀνθρώπου, καὶ τὸ τέταρτον ζῷον ὅμοιον ἀετῷ πετομένῳ·
verses.translit: kai to zoon to proton omoion leonti, kai to deyteron zoon omoion mosho, kai to triton zoon ehon to prosopon os anthropoy, kai to tetarton zoon omoion aeto petomeno*
verses.translation: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα, ἓν ⸂καθʼ ἓν⸃ ⸀αὐτῶν ⸀ἔχων ἀνὰ πτέρυγας ἕξ, κυκλόθεν καὶ ἔσωθεν γέμουσιν ὀφθαλμῶν· καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς λέγοντες· Ἅγιος ἅγιος ἅγιος κύριος, ὁ θεός, ὁ παντοκράτωρ, ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος.
verses.translit: kai ta tessara zoa, en kath' en auton ehon ana pterygas ex, kyklothen kai esothen gemoysin ofthalmon* kai anapaysin ouk ehoysin emeras kai nyktos legontes* Agios agios agios kyrios, o theos, o pantokrator, o en kai o on kai o erhomenos.
verses.translation: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him ; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

verses.original: καὶ ὅταν ⸀δώσουσιν τὰ ζῷα δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ εὐχαριστίαν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ ⸂τῷ θρόνῳ⸃, τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων,
verses.translit: kai otan dosoysin ta zoa doxan kai timen kai euharistian to kathimeno epi to throno, to zonti eis tous aionas ton aionon,
verses.translation: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

verses.original: πεσοῦνται οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἐνώπιον τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου, καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, καὶ βαλοῦσιν τοὺς στεφάνους αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, λέγοντες·
verses.translit: pesountai oi eikosi tessares presvyteroi enopion tou kathimenoy epi tou thronoy, kai proskynisoysin to zonti eis tous aionas ton aionon, kai valousin tous stefanoys auton enopion tou thronoy, legontes*
verses.translation: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

verses.original: Ἄξιος εἶ, ὁ κύριος καὶ ὁ θεὸς ⸀ἡμῶν, λαβεῖν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν, ὅτι σὺ ἔκτισας ⸀τὰ πάντα, καὶ διὰ τὸ θέλημά σου ἦσαν καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν.
verses.translit: Axios ei, o kyrios kai o theos emon, lavein ten doxan kai ten timen kai ten dynamin, oti su ektisas ta panta, kai dia to thelima soy esan kai ektisthisan.
verses.translation: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἐπὶ τὴν δεξιὰν τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου βιβλίον γεγραμμένον ἔσωθεν καὶ ⸀ὄπισθεν, κατεσφραγισμένον σφραγῖσιν ἑπτά.
verses.translit: Kai eidon epi ten dexian tou kathimenoy epi tou thronoy vivlion gegrammenon esothen kai opisthen, katesfragismenon sfragisin epta.
verses.translation: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

verses.original: καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον ἰσχυρὸν κηρύσσοντα ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ· Τίς ⸀ἄξιος ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ λῦσαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ;
verses.translit: kai eidon aggelon ishyron kiryssonta en fone megale* Tis axios anoixai to vivlion kai lusai tas sfragidas autou;
verses.translation: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

verses.original: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἐν τῷ ⸀οὐρανῷ ⸂οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐδὲ⸃ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό.
verses.translit: kai oudeis edynato en to ourano oude epi tes ges oude upokato tes ges anoixai to vivlion oute vlepein auto.
verses.translation: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.

verses.original: καὶ ⸀ἐγὼ ἔκλαιον πολὺ ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἄξιος εὑρέθη ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό·
verses.translit: kai ego eklaion polu oti oudeis axios eurethi anoixai to vivlion oute vlepein auto*
verses.translation: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.

verses.original: καὶ εἷς ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων λέγει μοι· Μὴ κλαῖε· ἰδοὺ ἐνίκησεν ὁ λέων ὁ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἰούδα, ἡ ῥίζα Δαυίδ, ⸀ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai eis ek ton presvyteron legei moi* Me klaie* idou enikisen o leon o ek tes fyles Ioyda, e Riza Dayid, anoixai to vivlion kai tas epta sfragidas autou.
verses.translation: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων ἀρνίον ⸀ἑστηκὸς ὡς ἐσφαγμένον, ⸀ἔχων κέρατα ἑπτὰ καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ἑπτά, ⸀οἵ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ πνεύματα τοῦ θεοῦ, ⸀ἀπεσταλμένοι εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν.
verses.translit: Kai eidon en meso tou thronoy kai ton tessaron zoon kai en meso ton presvyteron arnion estikos os esfagmenon, ehon kerata epta kai ofthalmous epta, oi eisin ta epta pneymata tou theou, apestalmenoi eis pasan ten gen.
verses.translation: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ εἴληφεν ἐκ τῆς δεξιᾶς τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου.
verses.translit: kai elthen kai eilifen ek tes dexias tou kathimenoy epi tou thronoy.
verses.translation: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

verses.original: καὶ ὅτε ἔλαβεν τὸ βιβλίον, τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα καὶ οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀρνίου, ἔχοντες ἕκαστος κιθάραν καὶ φιάλας χρυσᾶς γεμούσας θυμιαμάτων, αἵ εἰσιν ⸀αἱ προσευχαὶ τῶν ἁγίων·
verses.translit: kai ote elaven to vivlion, ta tessara zoa kai oi eikosi tessares presvyteroi epesan enopion tou arnioy, ehontes ekastos kitharan kai fialas hrysas gemoysas thymiamaton, ai eisin ai proseyhai ton agion*
verses.translation: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

verses.original: καὶ ᾄδουσιν ᾠδὴν καινὴν λέγοντες· Ἄξιος εἶ λαβεῖν τὸ βιβλίον καὶ ἀνοῖξαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐσφάγης καὶ ἠγόρασας τῷ ⸀θεῷ ἐν τῷ αἵματί σου ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς καὶ γλώσσης καὶ λαοῦ καὶ ἔθνους,
verses.translit: kai adoysin oden kainen legontes* Axios ei lavein to vivlion kai anoixai tas sfragidas autou, oti esfagis kai egorasas to theo en to aimati soy ek pasis fyles kai glossis kai laou kai ethnoys,
verses.translation: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

verses.original: καὶ ἐποίησας αὐτοὺς τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ⸀βασιλείαν καὶ ἱερεῖς, καὶ ⸀βασιλεύουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
verses.translit: kai epoiisas autous to theo emon vasileian kai iereis, kai vasileyoysin epi tes ges.
verses.translation: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ⸀ἤκουσα φωνὴν ἀγγέλων πολλῶν κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν ζῴων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, καὶ ἦν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν μυριάδες μυριάδων καὶ χιλιάδες χιλιάδων,
verses.translit: Kai eidon, kai ekoysa fonen aggelon pollon kyklo tou thronoy kai ton zoon kai ton presvyteron, kai en o arithmos auton myriades myriadon kai hiliades hiliadon,
verses.translation: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

verses.original: λέγοντες φωνῇ μεγάλῃ· Ἄξιόν ἐστιν τὸ ἀρνίον τὸ ἐσφαγμένον λαβεῖν τὴν δύναμιν ⸀καὶ πλοῦτον καὶ σοφίαν καὶ ἰσχὺν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν καὶ εὐλογίαν.
verses.translit: legontes fone megale* Axion estin to arnion to esfagmenon lavein ten dynamin kai plouton kai sofian kai ishun kai timen kai doxan kai eulogian.
verses.translation: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

verses.original: καὶ πᾶν κτίσμα ὃ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς ⸀θαλάσσης, καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς ⸀πάντα, ἤκουσα λέγοντας· Τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ ⸂τῷ θρόνῳ⸃ καὶ τῷ ἀρνίῳ ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν ⸀αἰώνων.
verses.translit: kai pan ktisma o en to ourano kai epi tes ges kai upokato tes ges kai epi tes thalassis, kai ta en autois panta, ekoysa legontas* To kathimeno epi to throno kai to arnio e eulogia kai e time kai e doxa kai to kratos eis tous aionas ton aionon.
verses.translation: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα ⸀ἔλεγον· Ἀμήν. καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν καὶ προσεκύνησαν.
verses.translit: kai ta tessara zoa elegon* Amin. kai oi presvyteroi epesan kai prosekynisan.
verses.translation: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον ⸀ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὸ ἀρνίον μίαν ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ σφραγίδων, καὶ ἤκουσα ἑνὸς ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων λέγοντος ὡς φωνῇ βροντῆς· ⸀Ἔρχου.
verses.translit: Kai eidon ote enoixen to arnion mian ek ton epta sfragidon, kai ekoysa enos ek ton tessaron zoon legontos os fone vrontes* Erhoy.
verses.translation: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.

verses.original: καὶ ⸂εἶδον, καὶ⸃ ἰδοὺ ἵππος λευκός, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἔχων τόξον, καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ στέφανος, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν νικῶν καὶ ἵνα νικήσῃ.
verses.translit: kai eidon, kai idou ippos leykos, kai o kathimenos ep' auton ehon toxon, kai edothi auto stefanos, kai exelthen nikon kai ina nikise.
verses.translation: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν ⸂σφραγῖδα τὴν δευτέραν⸃, ἤκουσα τοῦ δευτέρου ζῴου λέγοντος· Ἔρχου.
verses.translit: Kai ote enoixen ten sfragida ten deyteran, ekoysa tou deyteroy zooy legontos* Erhoy.
verses.translation: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἄλλος ἵππος πυρρός, καὶ τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἐδόθη αὐτῷ λαβεῖν τὴν εἰρήνην ἐκ τῆς γῆς ⸀καὶ ἵνα ἀλλήλους ⸀σφάξουσιν, καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ μάχαιρα μεγάλη.
verses.translit: kai exelthen allos ippos pyrros, kai to kathimeno ep' auton edothi auto lavein ten eirinin ek tes ges kai ina alliloys sfaxoysin, kai edothi auto mahaira megali.
verses.translation: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξε τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν τρίτην, ἤκουσα τοῦ τρίτου ζῴου λέγοντος· Ἔρχου. καὶ ⸀εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος μέλας, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἔχων ζυγὸν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Kai ote enoixe ten sfragida ten tritin, ekoysa tou tritoy zooy legontos* Erhoy. kai eidon, kai idou ippos melas, kai o kathimenos ep' auton ehon zygon en te heiri autou.
verses.translation: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

verses.original: καὶ ἤκουσα ⸀ὡς φωνὴν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων λέγουσαν· Χοῖνιξ σίτου δηναρίου, καὶ τρεῖς χοίνικες ⸀κριθῶν δηναρίου· καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον καὶ τὸν οἶνον μὴ ἀδικήσῃς.
verses.translit: kai ekoysa os fonen en meso ton tessaron zoon legoysan* Hoinix sitoy dinarioy, kai treis hoinikes krithon dinarioy* kai to elaion kai ton oinon me adikises.
verses.translation: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν τετάρτην, ἤκουσα ⸀φωνὴν τοῦ τετάρτου ζῴου λέγοντος· ⸀Ἔρχου.
verses.translit: Kai ote enoixen ten sfragida ten tetartin, ekoysa fonen tou tetartoy zooy legontos* Erhoy.
verses.translation: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.

verses.original: καὶ ⸂εἶδον, καὶ⸃ ἰδοὺ ἵππος χλωρός, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ ὄνομα αὐτῷ ὁ Θάνατος, καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἠκολούθει ⸂μετʼ αὐτοῦ⸃, καὶ ἐδόθη ⸀αὐτοῖς ἐξουσία ἐπὶ τὸ τέταρτον τῆς γῆς, ἀποκτεῖναι ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ καὶ ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν θηρίων τῆς γῆς.
verses.translit: kai eidon, kai idou ippos hloros, kai o kathimenos epano autou onoma auto o Thanatos, kai o adis ekoloythei met' autou, kai edothi autois exoysia epi to tetarton tes ges, apokteinai en Romfaia kai en limo kai en thanato kai upo ton thirion tes ges.
verses.translation: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν πέμπτην σφραγῖδα, εἶδον ὑποκάτω τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν ἐσφαγμένων διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ διὰ τὴν ⸀μαρτυρίαν ἣν εἶχον.
verses.translit: Kai ote enoixen ten pemptin sfragida, eidon upokato tou thysiastirioy tas psyhas ton esfagmenon dia ton logon tou theou kai dia ten martyrian en eihon.
verses.translation: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

verses.original: καὶ ἔκραξαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγοντες· Ἕως πότε, ὁ δεσπότης ὁ ἅγιος καὶ ἀληθινός, οὐ κρίνεις καὶ ἐκδικεῖς τὸ αἷμα ἡμῶν ἐκ τῶν κατοικούντων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς;
verses.translit: kai ekraxan fone megale legontes* Eos pote, o despotis o agios kai alithinos, ou krineis kai ekdikeis to aima emon ek ton katoikoynton epi tes ges;
verses.translation: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

verses.original: καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἑκάστῳ στολὴ λευκή, καὶ ἐρρέθη αὐτοῖς ἵνα ⸀ἀναπαύσονται ἔτι χρόνον ⸀μικρόν, ἕως ⸀πληρωθῶσιν καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ⸀αὐτῶν οἱ μέλλοντες ⸀ἀποκτέννεσθαι ὡς καὶ αὐτοί.
verses.translit: kai edothi autois ekasto stole leyki, kai errethi autois ina anapaysontai eti hronon mikron, eos plirothosin kai oi syndoyloi auton kai oi adelfoi auton oi mellontes apoktennesthai os kai autoi.
verses.translation: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν ἕκτην, καὶ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο, καὶ ὁ ἥλιος ⸂ἐγένετο μέλας⸃ ὡς σάκκος τρίχινος, καὶ ἡ σελήνη ὅλη ἐγένετο ὡς αἷμα,
verses.translit: Kai eidon ote enoixen ten sfragida ten ektin, kai seismos megas egeneto, kai o elios egeneto melas os sakkos trihinos, kai e selini oli egeneto os aima,
verses.translation: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;

verses.original: καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔπεσαν εἰς τὴν γῆν, ὡς συκῆ ⸀βάλλει τοὺς ὀλύνθους αὐτῆς ὑπὸ ἀνέμου μεγάλου σειομένη,
verses.translit: kai oi asteres tou ouranou epesan eis ten gen, os syke vallei tous olynthoys autes upo anemoy megaloy seiomeni,
verses.translation: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς ἀπεχωρίσθη ὡς βιβλίον ἑλισσόμενον, καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ νῆσος ἐκ τῶν τόπων αὐτῶν ἐκινήθησαν.
verses.translit: kai o ouranos apehoristhi os vivlion elissomenon, kai pan oros kai nesos ek ton topon auton ekinithisan.
verses.translation: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

verses.original: καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ μεγιστᾶνες καὶ οἱ χιλίαρχοι καὶ οἱ πλούσιοι καὶ οἱ ἰσχυροὶ καὶ πᾶς δοῦλος καὶ ἐλεύθερος ἔκρυψαν ἑαυτοὺς εἰς τὰ σπήλαια καὶ εἰς τὰς πέτρας τῶν ὀρέων·
verses.translit: kai oi vasileis tes ges kai oi megistanes kai oi hiliarhoi kai oi ploysioi kai oi ishyroi kai pas doulos kai eleytheros ekrypsan eaytous eis ta spilaia kai eis tas petras ton oreon*
verses.translation: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

verses.original: καὶ λέγουσιν τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ ταῖς πέτραις· Πέσετε ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς καὶ κρύψατε ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς τοῦ ἀρνίου,
verses.translit: kai legoysin tois oresin kai tais petrais* Pesete ef' emas kai krypsate emas apo prosopoy tou kathimenoy epi tou thronoy kai apo tes orges tou arnioy,
verses.translation: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

verses.original: ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ μεγάλη τῆς ὀργῆς ⸀αὐτῶν, καὶ τίς δύναται σταθῆναι;
verses.translit: oti elthen e emera e megali tes orges auton, kai tis dynatai stathenai;
verses.translation: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

verses.original: ⸀Μετὰ τοῦτο εἶδον τέσσαρας ἀγγέλους ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τὰς τέσσαρας γωνίας τῆς γῆς, κρατοῦντας τοὺς τέσσαρας ἀνέμους τῆς γῆς, ἵνα μὴ πνέῃ ἄνεμος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς μήτε ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης μήτε ἐπὶ ⸀πᾶν δένδρον.
verses.translit: Meta touto eidon tessaras aggeloys estotas epi tas tessaras gonias tes ges, kratountas tous tessaras anemoys tes ges, ina me pnee anemos epi tes ges mite epi tes thalassis mite epi pan dendron.
verses.translation: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

verses.original: καὶ εἶδον ἄλλον ἄγγελον ἀναβαίνοντα ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς ἡλίου, ἔχοντα σφραγῖδα θεοῦ ζῶντος, καὶ ἔκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ τοῖς τέσσαρσιν ἀγγέλοις οἷς ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἀδικῆσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν,
verses.translit: kai eidon allon aggelon anavainonta apo anatoles elioy, ehonta sfragida theou zontos, kai ekraxen fone megale tois tessarsin aggelois ois edothi autois adikesai ten gen kai ten thalassan,
verses.translation: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

verses.original: λέγων· Μὴ ἀδικήσητε τὴν γῆν μήτε τὴν θάλασσαν μήτε τὰ δένδρα, ⸀ἄχρι σφραγίσωμεν τοὺς δούλους τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: legon* Me adikisite ten gen mite ten thalassan mite ta dendra, ahri sfragisomen tous doyloys tou theou emon epi ton metopon auton.
verses.translation: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἐσφραγισμένων, ⸀ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τέσσαρες χιλιάδες, ⸀ἐσφραγισμένοι ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ·
verses.translit: Kai ekoysa ton arithmon ton esfragismenon, ekaton tesserakonta tessares hiliades, esfragismenoi ek pasis fyles yion Israil*
verses.translation: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

verses.original: ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰούδα δώδεκα χιλιάδες ⸀ἐσφραγισμένοι, ἐκ φυλῆς Ῥουβὴν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Γὰδ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,
verses.translit: ek fyles Ioyda dodeka hiliades esfragismenoi, ek fyles Royven dodeka hiliades, ek fyles Gad dodeka hiliades,
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.original: ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσὴρ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Νεφθαλὶμ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,
verses.translit: ek fyles Aser dodeka hiliades, ek fyles Nefthalim dodeka hiliades, ek fyles Manasse dodeka hiliades,
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.original: ἐκ φυλῆς Συμεὼν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Λευὶ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰσσαχὰρ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,
verses.translit: ek fyles Symeon dodeka hiliades, ek fyles Leyi dodeka hiliades, ek fyles Issahar dodeka hiliades,
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.original: ἐκ φυλῆς Ζαβουλὼν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰωσὴφ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Βενιαμὶν δώδεκα χιλιάδες ⸀ἐσφραγισμένοι.
verses.translit: ek fyles Zavoylon dodeka hiliades, ek fyles Iosef dodeka hiliades, ek fyles Veniamin dodeka hiliades esfragismenoi.
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ὄχλος πολύς, ὃν ἀριθμῆσαι ⸀αὐτὸν οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο, ἐκ παντὸς ἔθνους καὶ φυλῶν καὶ λαῶν καὶ γλωσσῶν, ⸀ἑστῶτες ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀρνίου, περιβεβλημένους στολὰς λευκάς, καὶ ⸀φοίνικες ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν·
